test: T62 stage 2 memory contrast (with vs without reviewed knowledge)

incomplete: pair2: no SessionReference/Attempt retained for cp-4ddffe2e528b, cp-7e4e0f820b6e

result_cannot_be_upgraded_by_evidence_le: pair1 is cited from a pre-incident record and pair2 lacks a SessionReference; neither raises nor lowers the INCONCLUSIVE conclusion, and neither may be used to turn it into PASS or FAIL.
why_inconclusive: The knowledge provably reaches the memory arm's frozen prompt, but the two arms' outcomes cannot be separated at n=3: the control arm passed all three pairs, the memory arm passed two. That is not evidence of benefit, and it is not evidence of harm either.

what_is_proven: a candidate entry is produced deterministically from a verdict
a human edit is applied through memory-preview + memory-apply (CAS)
the entry is promoted to verified through context-verify with evidence
a fresh Session receives the entry in its frozen Effective Prompt
the Effective Prompt records the entry id and context version
layer1_memory_chain_established.what_is_not_proven_here: that carrying the entry changes the Worker's outcome

layer2_memory_benefit_not_proven.reading: The control arm did at least as well as the memory arm. With three pairs and n=1 per pair this shows neither a benefit nor a degradation; it only shows the sample cannot separate them.

layer3_verifier_maybe_mismeasuring.what_happened: the with-memory arm ran the full test suite successfully (54 passed) and was rejected solely on file_contains: normalized_1000; the without-memory arm passed every assertion
layer3_verifier_maybe_mismeasuring.consequence: a rejected verdict on this task may reflect an over-strict text assertion rather than a missing feature, so rejected must not be read as 'the implementation failed'
layer3_verifier_maybe_mismeasuring.supports: re-run with behavioural assertions before trusting a rejected verdict as a failure

design.why_not_via_ld_model: T62-F01: the decision model paraphrased two byte-identical goals into different task texts and different assertions, which would confound the memory variable.

arms.with_memory: clean project carrying the human-reviewed verified entry

direction_of_disagreement.reading: The disagreement is one-sided: no pair shows the memory arm passing while the control arm failed, and pair2 shows the control arm passing while the memory arm was rejected. The earlier claim that the arms diverged in both directions does not match the data and has been withdrawn.
